meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 帮助你把脑科学和生物医学数据(如MRI、EEG、PET等)按BIDS标准整理成统一目录和文件命名,补写元数据说明;还能查询已有数据集、检查是否符合规范、转换DICOM、创建衍生数据。
howto.when: 当你提到BIDS,或要求整理/查询脑与生物医学数据、检查规范合规性、转换DICOM、写元数据或创建衍生数据时触发。

say.text: 检查这个数据集是否符合BIDS规范。

say.note: 返回匹配的文件路径和元数据。

howto.what_en: Helps you organize neuroscience and biomedical data (e.g., MRI, EEG, PET) into BIDS-compliant folder and file naming, add metadata sidecars, query existing datasets, check compliance, convert DICOM, and create derivatives.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention BIDS or ask to organize/query brain and biomedical data, check BIDS compliance, convert DICOM, write metadata, or create derivatives.
